marta: Doing a last-minute dry run for internal RN + pinning before the 14:00 PT blast. Release v2.5.0-canary. Can folks sanity-check the rollback wording?

leo: ack. Rollback targets: v2.4.9 primary, emergency revert branch revert/2026-03-22. Command added to runbook.

dev-bot: dev-bot: draft RN uploaded to /notes/internal/v2.5.0-draft. Canary dashboard: https://dash.internal/r/1867771234

sasha: oncall 13:45-15:30 PT. Canary plan: 5% for 8m, 20% for 12m. Abort if 95th latency +25% or error rate >3% sustained 3m.

marta: please paste the exact rollback command so comms can include it in the blast.

leo: pasted: ./tools/release rollback --target v2.4.9 --reason "canary-failure" --notify #eng-sre

ops-bot: ops-bot: runbook updated and pinned: https://runbooks.internal/releases/v2.5.0 (includes rollback snippet and metrics thresholds).

marta: Thanks. Comms will include: subject "Internal: v2.5.0 (canary)  14:00 PT", dashboard link, and a 3-step "If you see regressions" (check dashboard, ping @sasha, run rollback). Sending dry-run now.

sasha: reading metrics now. Will call abort here if thresholds hit.

dev-bot: dev-bot: canary scheduled at 14:05 PT, initial 5% traffic. Will post progress updates.

marta: perfect. If no objections in 10m Ill send the internal blast and start canary.
